name: m5-mapparams-audit
description: Caller audit of the uniques prototype's `mapParams` weak scope (retronym/scala#240): which type maps enter it, from which compiler code, and how often params are actually cloned. The escape check found this scope's uninterned types in pickles, infos and trees; this asks where the mapping is requested. Counts cover the whole fork (setup, warmup and measured compiles).
